source.where: games.fun research/foundations/evidence/studio-v2-live-hang-up-on-them-creator-feedback-2026-10-07.json (typed into live Studio 2026-10-07; the creator rejected the build)

prompt: A zombie like game where you have to defend a token from scam callers by shooting with a gun. The zombies should look like the characters in the linked image

images.label: scam-callers-reference
images.describe: a screenshot of another studio's game: toon humanoid call-centre workers with headsets, short-sleeve shirts and lanyards, in rows of cubicles with monitors
images.kept: private: the creator's upload or a third party's picture, never in git; the runner finds it by sha256 in the private refs folder (RUNNER.md)

ledger.means: A token in the world is what the players defend; the game is lost if it falls
Scam callers come at the token like a zombie horde, in numbers and waves
Players shoot them with guns, and a hit that does not kill reads (a flash, a health bar)

ledger.words: The zombies should look like the characters in the linked image
ledger.means: The enemies look like the image's characters: toon call-centre workers with headsets, short-sleeve shirts and lanyards

multiplayer.bar: Two players in one game, in sync: each screen shows the other player as a character where they really are, in the same round or run, and each sees their own score as their own.

policy: The image is a reference for the look; nothing from it is copied into the game

control.text: The game includes a working chess board
